1422.name: Yoshi coins collected
desc: Number of Yoshi (dragon) coins Mario has collected in the current level. Incremented by the block/coin interaction
code when a Yoshi coin is touched and read by the status bar to draw the coin count, and by the end-of-level code.
Values: 0 = none collected.

1423.name: Switch palace color
desc: Which switch palace colour is involved. Cleared to 0 on pipe entry; set by the P-switch/coin tile routine to
(tile - $EC + 1) when a switch palace tile is processed, and read by Mario block collision to pick the block side.
Values: 0 = none; 1.. = colour of the switch palace block.

1424.name: Course clear delay timer
desc: Delay used by the level-end tally. The tally state machine loads it with $28 before moving to the next state,
and course clear state 1 (bonus star line) counts it down. State 2 also reads it to test the saved star count
(0 = no stars to count up). Both uses are inside the course clear sequence.

1425.name: Bonus game flag
desc: Probably the 'play the bonus game after this level' flag. The status bar code sets it to $FF when enough bonus
stars have been collected, and the cutscene level list also sets it to $FF. Level loading, game mode 14 and the
Mario Start routines read it to decide whether the level ends in the bonus game.
Values: 0 = no bonus game; $FF = go to the bonus game.

1426.name: Message box trigger
desc: Which message box is showing. Mario's scripted walk and the message-trigger sprites ($19/$3E) increment it to
start a box, Yoshi sets it to 3 for his message, and the message box routine clears it to 0 when the box closes.
Values: 0 = no message box; 1 = message 1; 2 = message 2; 3 = Yoshi message.

1427.name: Bowser animation mode
desc: Bowser's drawing/animation mode, used by the Mode 7 tilemap routine that positions his picture. Cleared to 0 by
the main Bowser logic, set by the hurt reaction, and set to 3 while he bounces on the floor (phase 9).

142A.name: Static camera region centre
desc: Horizontal centre of the region in which Mario can move without scrolling the screen. Initialised to $0080 at
level start; L/R scrolling moves it. Scroll code derives the left and right scroll lines [$142C] and [$142E]
from it. Bit 0 is cleared when L/R scrolling is active (TRB).
Values: $0080 = default centre.

142C.name: Left scroll line
desc: Mario's left scroll line, computed each frame as [$142A] - $0C. [$142E] is the right line ([$142A] + $0C).
Scroll code indexes it with Y (0 = left, 2 = right) to get Mario's distance from the line; zero = no scroll.

1430.name: Sprite tile range, lower bound
desc: Set to $C4 by the level buffer setup. Together with $1431 it gives the Map16 tile range that the sprite
vertical-check and map16 lookup treat specially (probably the slope/solid range sprites react to).
Read by the sprite check as a lower bound (CMP).

1431.name: Sprite tile range, upper bound
desc: Set to $CA by the level buffer setup. Upper bound (exclusive) of the Map16 tile range tested with $1430;
the sprite map16 lookup applies the check only if [$1430] <= tile < [$1431].

1433.name: Iris / keyhole circle size
desc: Radius of the circular iris wipe window. The peace pose / iris-out effect sets it to $F0 and shrinks it; the screen
layer setup stores new sizes; the iris half-width lookup and the keyhole code in the per-frame Mario state read it.

1434.name: Keyhole timer
desc: Keyhole animation timer. The keyhole sprite sets it to $30 for the exit animation; the per-frame Mario state code
stores into it and counts it, and level start tests it (with $13CF) before choosing the setup path.

1436.name: Keyhole X position, low byte
desc: Low byte of the keyhole X position (RAM_KeyHolePos1), written by the keyhole sprite ($01:E227) and by Mario
animation 0 (together with $14B4). High byte is $1437. Reused as the next free particle slot by the switch
palace ! block particles routine, and written by the Mode 7 boss room platform code.

1437.name: Keyhole X position, high byte
desc: High byte of the keyhole X position ([$1436] is the low byte), set by the keyhole sprite. Also reused as a spawn
timer by the switch palace ! block particle routine.

1438.name: Keyhole Y position, low byte
desc: Low byte of the keyhole Y position (RAM_KeyHolePos2), written by the keyhole sprite and Mario animation 0 (with
$14B6). High byte is $1439. The switch palace ! block particle routine reuses it to save the OAM offset.

1439.name: Keyhole Y position, high byte
desc: High byte of the keyhole Y position ([$1438] is the low byte), set by the keyhole sprite. Also reused as the
effect phase by the switch palace ! block particle routine.

143A.name: Mario Start graphics upload flag
desc: Set to 1 by level start setup when the Mario Start! graphics are waiting to be sent by DMA; cleared to 0 in game
mode 12. The NMI handler and NMI tail read it to decide whether to do that upload.
Values: 0 = nothing to upload; 1 = upload pending.

143C.name: Message animation position
desc: Animation position of the Mario Start / death message. The death routine sets it to $C0; game mode 11 reads it
and updates it (value must be divisible by 4 per the source comment).

143E.name: Scroll sprite / cutscene number
desc: Shared byte. In levels it is the number of the active layer 2 scroll routine (RAM_ScrollSprNum), cleared at level
load and set by 'start a scroll command sprite'. In the cutscene/ending code it is the sub-scene number, stepped
to the next scene by the scripted cutscene movement.

143F.name: Scroll command / cutscene timer
desc: Shared byte. In level scroll code, non-zero means a scroll command is already active (a new one is skipped).
In cutscene code it is a frame countdown (animation timer, frame duration, scene wait) decremented per frame
and acted on at zero. Cleared at level load.

1440.name: Auto-scroll command / cutscene frame
desc: Shared byte. In level scroll sprite code it is the current auto-scroll command for layer 1 ([$1441] is the layer 2
command); the path scroll sets [$1440]/[$1441] from a table. Also indexed as [$1440+X] for the layer 2 ON/OFF
switch stage index. In cutscene code it is an animation frame or timer ($FF = hidden/first frame).

1441.name: Layer 2 scroll command / timer
desc: In scroll sprite code: the layer 2 command (companion of $1440), the shake timer for layer 3 handlers, the number
of entries for the layer 2 smash. In cutscenes: a countdown ($30 loaded, decremented by the colour flash state).

1442.name: Scroll step / cutscene state
1442.kind: byte table (index = layer offset) or byte
desc: Scroll sprites index it per layer (X = 0 layer 1, 4 layer 2) as the current path node or stage, incremented as each
segment finishes. In cutscene and credits code it is the scene state/substate, incremented to advance
the scene. Cleared at the start of a scene.

1443.name: Text timer / scroll state
desc: In the cutscene main entry it is the text timer (counts down; bits 7-5 select the text line). In the layer 2 smash
scroll sprite it is added to [$1442] as a step index into the smash tables, and the ON/OFF switch stores its new
state here. Also set to $FF by the rising/sideways sprites near Mario.

1444.name: Path segments left / flag
1444.kind: byte table (index = layer offset) or flag
desc: Scroll sprites: number of path segments left for layer 1 (and [$1445] for layer 2), also an offset to the first
table entry. Pause timer for the smash sprite. Overworld: non-zero when a tile step has started. Cutscenes: an
object-active flag (1 = spawn the falling object).

1445.name: Path segments left / step counter
desc: Scroll sprites: segments left for layer 2, number of range entries, wait timer for the ON/OFF switch. Cutscenes and
Mario cutscene animation: a step counter, incremented by script command $21 or counted down as an animation tick.

1446.name: Layer scroll speed X / active flag
1446.kind: byte table (index = layer offset, X = 0 or 4)
desc: Horizontal scroll speed word for layers 1/2 used by the scroll sprites, whose sub-pixel accumulator is [$144E]; cleared
when a path ends. Credits scroll stores speeds here. In cutscenes it is a non-zero flag for the rope column and the
rising sprite being active.

1447.name: Cutscene fall speed / timer
desc: Cutscene object timer and Y speed: the castle scene increases the fall speed by 2, the effects state decrements it,
and the frame sequence steps it to the next table entry on expiry. Cleared by the scene step routine.

1448.name: Layer Y scroll speed
1448.kind: byte table (index = layer offset, X = 0 or 4)
desc: Vertical scroll speed for layer 1 (X = 0) and layer 2 (X = 4) set by the scroll sprite code; cleared on init. Sub-pixel
accumulator is [$1450]. Layer 3 handlers copy the layer 1 speed here.

1449.name: Rope column pause timer
desc: Pause timer for the three-tile sprite and rope column in the cutscene code; counted down each frame, and the routine
returns while it is non-zero.

144A.name: Scroll / cutscene object index
desc: Cleared by the scroll sprite init routines. Read by the layer 2 ON/OFF switch, and by cutscene code as an index X
for the carried item sprite and the accessory/rope column draw. Exact purpose differs per user (probably a sprite
or object index).

144C.name: Layer 2 Y speed
desc: Layer 2 vertical scroll speed (layer 1 uses [$1448]). Cleared by scroll sprites (ON/OFF switch, sink or rise,
init, and path scroll). The carried item / Mario exit walk also writes it.

144D.name: Cutscene delay timer
desc: Delay counted down every 4th frame by the cutscene main entry while non-zero. The rising/sideways sprite code sets it
to $D0; the final scene state waits for it and [$1443] to be zero (text and fade finished). Also cleared by the layer 2
ON/OFF switch scroll sprite.

144E.name: Scroll sub-pixel / limit, idle timer
144E.kind: byte table (X/Y = layer offset) or timer
desc: Scroll sprites: sub-pixel accumulator for horizontal scroll (low byte plus speed [$1446]) and, indexed by Y, a position
limit compared against [$1462+Y]. Credits scroll uses it as an accumulator. Overworld walk: idle timer. Ending scene:
walk animation timer (6). Overworld load sets it to $0F (purpose unclear).

144F.name: Walk frame toggle
desc: Credits scene walk frame: toggled between 0 and 1 by the substate 0 routine, reset to 0 when the actors are initialised.

1450.name: Layer Y scroll sub-pixel / limit
desc: Scroll sprite data cleared on init: layer sub-pixel accumulator for vertical scroll, and a limit compared against
the position [$1464+Y]. Layer 3 handler compares [$1462+Y] with it.

1454.name: Layer 2 Y sub-pixel
desc: Layer 2 vertical sub-pixel position. Only ever cleared (0) by the scroll sprite init, path scroll and the sink or rise
sprite.

1456.name: Scroll layer offset
desc: Which layer the scroll routines are currently processing, used as an X/Y offset into the per-layer tables.
Set to 0 for the layer 1 phase and 4 for the layer 2 phase by the scroll run routine.
Values: 0 = layer 1; 4 = layer 2.

1458.name: Pose / layer X speed
desc: Credits scene: the pose number of the actors, set from actor speeds and counted down by the ending. Layer 3 scroll
handler: X speed added to the sub-pixel accumulator [$145C]. Cleared at level load and credits init.

1459.name: Pose timer
desc: Pose timer for the credits scene, set to 6 when initialised and reloaded to 6 by the eggshell routine; decremented by the
landing pose animation.

145A.name: Layer 3 Y speed / visible mask
desc: Layer 3 scroll handler: speed value (multiplied by 16 into the accumulator [$145C]). Credits: bit mask of which of the
seven actors are visible, set by 'release the seven actors' and used by the egg drawing. Cleared on init.

145B.name: Ending wait timer
desc: Ending timer. The enemy scene sets it to $00FF as a hold time once the layers meet; the mode entry code counts it down
and the release routine uses it as the number of actors released so far.

145C.name: Layer 3 sub-pixel accumulator
desc: Sub-pixel accumulator for layer 3 scroll: ([$145C] & $FF) + [$1458], and [$145A] * 16 added, carry kept. Also tested by the
ending as 'release in progress'. Cleared at level load.

145D.name: Ending stage delay
desc: Delay timer before the next stage of the ending eggshell/Yoshi scene; loaded with $F0.

1460.name: Layer 3 direction
desc: Direction value for the layer 3 scroll handler, loaded into Y as an index. Cleared/set at scroll sprite init and updated
by the layer 3 handler.
